No network, no model call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL=https://w.example`, run `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit. YOU MAY EDIT ONLY: storygame/runtime/item_facts.py, storygame/runtime/cloudflare.py (only if truly needed), tests/test_observation_prompt.py (new). Never edit storygame/runtime/observation.py, packages/, data/, docs/, worker/, or any other file. Never make a network call.

READ FIRST: .plans/grounded-llm-environment-narration.md ('Required architecture' 1-2, T3, and the note that T3 may bypass command_consumed engine text only as an experimental option), storygame/runtime/observation.py (ObservationRequest, build_observation_context, ObservationContext.prompt_fields; finished, do not change), storygame/runtime/item_facts.py (ItemFactsProvider: _player_lines, _things_block, _thing_names, _section_user_prompt, __call__ with the engine-text shortcut when command_consumed and prior_steps), storygame/runtime/cloudflare.py (_section_user_prompt and how CONSTRAINTS are assembled), storygame/runtime/capture.py (WorldCapture.before_turn sets provider.prior_steps and provider.command_consumed), docs/narrator-writing-guide.md (plain 12th-grade words, one idea per sentence) and scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/boarding_probe.py (how to capture the exact narrator request with a stubbed Jev, stubbed item-facts matcher and a replaced provider._dispatch; reuse that approach in your tests, importing by path).

BEHAVIOR. Add a public attribute `observation_request: ObservationRequest | None = None` on ItemFactsProvider. When it is None, EVERYTHING is byte-for-byte as today. When a caller sets it (the experiment harness will; the engine will not until a later task): (1) the engine-text shortcut in __call__ is skipped, so a consumed boarding command goes to the narrator; (2) the prompt is built from `build_observation_context(world, protagonist_id, request, completed_actions=self.prior_steps)` over the provider's current working world (after the implicit moves, so a moved item shows its new place and holder, never a stale label); (3) the PLAYER section keeps the ORIGINAL player action line (request.action) as the action, and when completed actions exist adds ONE separate line that begins `Already done:` followed by the steps, so the narrator reports their result and is not asked to do them again (this replaces the `Just before this:` handling and the consumed-command replacement for this mode only); (4) every context.visible_things entry that is not already listed is added to THINGS in exactly the existing line format (`- Name. Place: X.` or `- Name. Held by: X.` when held and the provider's held_by option is on), without duplicates and without removing any existing THINGS line; (5) when context.required is non-empty, add ONE CONSTRAINTS line in plain 12th-grade words: `Show these in your reply: <names joined with commas>.`; (6) contingent_things are never added to THINGS and never required (they only exist for an open request and are for later tasks); (7) nothing hidden, no entity ids, no internal text enter the prompt. No story vocabulary anywhere in your code. Do not touch the item-facts reply contract, recovery, or capture; do not add any engine-written environment sentence.

TESTS FIRST in tests/test_observation_prompt.py (hermetic, socket patched to fail, real package data/stories/continuity-initiative plus one synthetic package built by copying it to tmp_path and editing the yaml the way tests/test_seating.py does only if that is cheap; otherwise a second real-package case): (a) default off: for 'Go to the truck.' from outside_house with the boarding stubs, the captured narrator request user text equals what the same capture returns with observation_request None BEFORE your change (assert the PLAYER section still holds `Just before this:` and THINGS still lists only Kristin); (b) on, 'Enter the truck.' (kind enter, focus the truck's entity id): THINGS gains `- Kristin's laptop. Place: passenger seat.`, PLAYER keeps `Enter the truck.` and has one `Already done:` line holding both steps, CONSTRAINTS has the Show-these line naming the laptop, and the product __call__ no longer returns engine text (last_turn_engine_text False, dispatch reached); (c) stale label: after the laptop is moved to Kristin before capture, the line is `Held by` (or no seat label) and never `passenger seat`; (d) a hidden story item never appears in the prompt; (e) 'Approach the truck.' (kind none) adds nothing and requires nothing; (f) the same request twice gives identical text; (g) no entity id string from world.entity_ids() appears as a whole token in the added lines. Run them, see them fail, then build. FINISH: ruff check and ruff format every file you touched; report pass counts and any behavior you could not satisfy.
